fieldNotes.truckGate: Continuous chain-link perimeter fence runs the full Harper Rd frontage (confirmed in multiple Street View panos). A single controlled main drive leaves Harper Rd into the property. A driver review explicitly states 'when coming in through the gate ... go to Dock A and check in.' Gate is positively present.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No distinct guard booth resolved in overhead or Street View imagery; the office building sits immediately at the front circle. Check-in appears to be at 'Dock A' inside the plant. Classified guardShack false / remoteGs true, but flagged uncertain - a booth may be obscured by trees at the drive entrance.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Main drive runs ~150m+ from Harper Rd to the truck/dock area on the west side; ample queue depth for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large open paved truck yard on the W/NW holds 30-40 parked trailers in rows (westyard/nwcorner imagery).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved drive apron and large open yard provide room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~30 estimated from rhythmic dock bays along the west building face; partly obscured by building shadow - low-confidence count.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur runs along the SW/W property edge with rail cars present in imagery (truckaccess/swdocks/westedge views).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Solon OH is a dense industrial/office suburb in the Cleveland metro, adjacent to the I-422/Harper Rd interchange.
